غَلَاقٌ : see غَلَقٌ. ＝
-A2- It is also a subst. from the verb in the phrase أُغْلِقَ فُلَانٌ بِجَرِيرَتِهِ [q. v.]: 'Adee Ibn-Zeyd says, “وَتَقُولُ العُدَاةُ أَوْدَى عَدِىٌّ
وَبَنُوهُ قَدْ أَيْقَنُوا بِالغَلَاقِ
” [And the enemies say, “ 'Adee has perished, and his sons have made sure of being surrendered ”]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
